name: 茶盏
subject: A substantial celadon ceramic tea bowl in three-quarter view, broad open oval rim with dark amber tea clearly visible, thick pale green lip, darker jade foot ring and one small angular kiln crack. No handle, no saucer, no steam.

name: 竹笛
subject: A short thick diagonal bamboo flute with four clearly separated dark finger holes, two raised bamboo nodes, open dark end, a red cord knot and two short tassel ends tied near lower node. Honey bamboo with olive shading. Must clearly read as playable flute, not plain stick.

name: 战马铃
subject: A heavy weathered bronze horse harness bell hanging from a short broad dark leather strap, two bronze rivets, domed stepped shoulder, flared square-edged skirt, dark open bottom with a visible hanging clapper. One restrained turquoise patina patch. Practical cavalry equipment.

name: 鼓槌
subject: A diagonal stout wooden war-drum mallet, large cylindrical padded oxblood-red leather striking head with pale wrapping bands, short walnut handle, leather wrist loop. Broad striking head and handle clearly different materials; not weapon or tiny spoon.

name: 明月佩
subject: A broad ivory-silver crescent moon pendant suspended from a dark navy knotted cord, thick dimensional crescent with chipped angular inner edge, small blue jade bead below, one muted bronze attachment loop. Clear transparent crescent opening, three discrete cool silver shades, no glow.

name: 补子官徽
subject: A square Chinese official rank cloth badge, thick dark indigo embroidered fabric with ochre gold stitched border, central bold cream crane bird with angular wings above three teal wave steps. Small folded lower corner exposes brown backing. Clear textile patch, no flag pole, no writing, no tiny embroidery.

name: 星斗盘
subject: A compact ancient Chinese bronze astronomical dial in three-quarter view: thick stepped round brass rim, dark indigo inset plate, seven large pale gold square star studs connected by a sparse angular Big Dipper path, short bronze sighting pin raised on one edge. Small top hanging loop. Readable astronomical instrument not ornate jewel.

name: 香囊
subject: A broad dark indigo woven incense sachet with angular folded lower corners, gathered mouth held by a thick ochre cord, short cord loop and one small muted gold geometric stitched patch. Three dry tan herb leaves visible at the open mouth, cloth flap thickness clear. No jewels, no filigree, no bottle.
